### Run command (from README.md)

```bash
python3 tracker.py
python3 -m http.server 8080  # then open http://localhost:8080/dashboard.html
```

The tracker uses Playwright headless Chrome + curl (HTTP/1.1 for Best Buy) + requests as fallback, with 1.5s polite delays between requests.
